facts:
Hepzamirah is a mortal nephilim daughter of Baphomet, once archpriestess of the cult and mistress of the Ivory Labyrinth templars; she is not an ordinary demon.
She sacrificed her mother and hundreds of siblings to Baphomet and hates having been discarded.
Her native appetite is domination, owning bodies and inflicting pain; no native seduction line exists.
Her living body is the mod's authored Trickster vessel: a scarred side of the face, a milk-white unseeing eye and a horn stump. These are authored continuity, not native anatomy evidence.
No canon genital detail, measurements, or hair, eye or skin colour is supplied; do not invent them or fix the Commander's anatomy.
scene: EXPLICIT CONTINUATION: Trickster route, Chapter 5, Drezen, her small hot room behind the smith's forge; the door cannot be locked or shut. Every object in the room is a trophy she took, was given or refused to give back (the history may supply the laundress's split paddle, the RETURNED TO SENDER note, Ember's blue flowers, the crystal-cutter's lens, Mutasafen's letter, the sawn horn splinters, or the Apprentice's dried hands on the bedpost). The Commander sat beside her on the mended cot; she took the Commander's hand, turned it over and studied it the way she studied her shelf, and said she keeps this too, she has decided, and that the Commander has seen what she does to people who take her things. Continue: she makes the claim physical. The Commander is added to the collection on her terms; possession is the heat, the trophies are watching. Only Hepzamirah and the Commander are present. End with the Commander still in her room before dawn.
